baseline.window: function observationWindow(sets,w){const requestedWindow={...w};const actual=sets.flatMap(z=>z.a.filter(q=>!q.held&&Number.isFinite(q.t)&&q.t>=w.start&&q.t<=w.end).map(q=>q.t));const end=actual.length?Math.max(...actual):null;if(end!==null){w.end=end;w.endLabel=new Date(end).toISOString().slice(0,10);if(w.start===end)w.start=end-1;for(const z of sets){const held=z.a.filter(q=>q.held&&q.t>end);z.a=z.a.filter(q=>q.t<=end);if(held.length&&z.a.length&&z.a.at(-1).t<end)z.a.push({...z.a.at(-1),t:end,held:true})}}w.requestedWindow=requestedWindow;return w}
